destination.$comment: Retained Panel relocation to a source or explicit target context, or a new Workspace; optional targetPanelId selects the graft leaf.

terminalGeometry.$comment: Semantic validation additionally requires columns * rows <= 262144, columns * cellPixelWidth <= 65535, and rows * cellPixelHeight <= 65535. The cellPixelWidth/cellPixelHeight pair must be either both positive (pixels known) or both zero (pixels unknown); a mixed pair is invalid.

tabCloseAttemptGeneration.$comment: One nonzero Close attempt-generation domain, distinct from Workbench revision; increment must be checked.

workspaceCloseMemberStatus.$comment: A member entry carries only its own terminal disposition; the close revision lives solely in the scope-level status.

exec.$comment: Rust and TypeScript enforce the combined 30 KiB UTF-8 and worst-case escaped-content budgets.

launchProfileSelector.$comment: Rust and TypeScript additionally enforce 512 UTF-8 bytes.

environment.$comment: Rust and TypeScript additionally enforce ASCII-case-unique names and 1024 combined UTF-8 name/value bytes.

worktreeListEntry.$comment: Bindings additionally validate absolute/NUL-free raw byte paths and Unicode scalar text.
